What does MaxToki actually learn?

Investigate 12,214 internal biological concepts in MaxToki-217M

This atlas decomposes MaxToki's residual stream into individual learned features via TopK sparse autoencoders and asks: do they encode recognizable biology? Yes — with 68–81% annotation rate and 10 coherent co-activation modules per layer. But do they encode regulatory logic? No — 0% TF specificity across all tests.

What is this atlas?
What is MaxToki?
A temporal single-cell foundation model (Llama decoder, 217M params) trained on ~175M human cells. It generates cell states across developmental trajectories via rank-value encoded gene tokens.
What are SAE features?
TopK sparse autoencoders decompose each layer’s 1,232-dimensional residual stream into ~4,928 overcomplete directions. Each feature fires on a coherent biological signal — a pathway, a cell type, or a gene program.
The central finding
MaxToki’s features encode rich co-expression structure (80.7% annotated) but zero directed TF→target regulatory logic (0/48 TFs specific under CRISPRi). The model knows what genes do together, not who controls whom.

About this Atlas

Model
MaxToki-217M-HF — a causal Llama decoder (11 layers, 1,232 hidden dim, 8 attention heads) trained on ~175M single-cell transcriptomes in two stages: (1) next-token prediction on rank-value encoded genes, (2) temporal trajectory modelling with time tokens.
Weights: theodoris-lab/MaxToki
SAE Architecture
TopK sparse autoencoders (Gao et al. 2024). d_SAE = 4,928 (4× overcomplete), k = 32, trained on 1M positions from 500 K562 control cells per layer. Decoder columns unit-normalised after every gradient step. No L1 penalty — TopK enforces exact sparsity.
Methodology
Based on: Kendiukhov 2026, “Sparse autoencoders reveal organized biological knowledge but minimal regulatory logic in single-cell foundation models” (arXiv:2603.02952). Full pipeline code: Biodyn-AI/bio-sae.
Scope
3 layers analysed: L0 (post-embedding), L5 (mid-depth), L11 (final transformer block). 12,214 alive features total. Annotation via GO BP, KEGG, Reactome, TRRUST v2. Perturbation response tested against 100 Replogle K562 CRISPRi targets (48 TRRUST TFs + 52 non-TFs).
